correctness.rationale: Li--Zeng's companion-rectangle proof reduces both cases to parameter averages of commutator outputs with input Lp size comparable to |Q|^(1/p). The normable Lorentz functional sup_F |F|^(-1/q') integral_F |h| is equivalent to weak Lq and satisfies integral Minkowski, so their final estimate changes exactly to m_Q <= C ||[b,H_gamma]|| |Q|^(1/p-1/q). This is precisely the anisotropic Campanato normalization.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Li--Zeng prove all-dimensional necessity only for p=q, while Oikari proves off-diagonal sufficiency in all dimensions but restricts necessity to the plane. Exact and synonymous searches and the current SCOPE archive did not locate the weak-Lq, all-dimensional off-diagonal necessity statement. The very recent Li--Zeng preprint leaves residual risk of unindexed simultaneous work.

value.rationale: The theorem closes an explicit higher-dimensional off-diagonal necessity gap and strengthens the target hypothesis to weak Lq. In Oikari's established sufficiency region it makes weak and strong off-diagonal boundedness equivalent and yields the full all-dimensional characterization.
